description: Grading rubric builder — Analytic grading rubric for any assignment: criteria with observable descriptors for each performance level, points allocated offline so they sum exactly to the total (largest-remainder rounding), point ranges per level, vague-wording flags and a markdown table. Optional: criteria (comma list), levels (2-6, default 4), points (default 100), level (student level). Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).
